features.name: mean_content_word_length_oc
features.definition: Across all counter-argument comments, what is the average character length of content words (non-stopwords)?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments with json.loads into a list of strings. If malformed/missing, return null. Lowercase all comments and extract tokens with re.findall(r"[a-z]+(?:'[a-z]+)?", text) (alphabetic words; URLs not specially removed). Remove tokens in the NLTK English stopword list (nltk.corpus.stopwords.words('english')). Pool the remaining content-word tokens across all comments and return the mean number of letters/characters per token (apostrophes excluded from length). If the list is empty or no content words remain, return null.

h0: mean_content_word_length_oc has no association with the probability that the OP changed their view (delta).
h1: Greater mean_content_word_length_oc is associated with a higher probability that the OP changed their view.
note: Persuasiveness operationalized as the dataset outcome delta (OP view change); association only, not causal. Assumptions: content words = tokens not in NLTK English stopwords; length in characters; words pooled across all available comments (word-weighted, not per-comment mean). Raw text may contain view-change/delta announcements or later replies; no semantic filtering applied. Comment order/timing unknown. Only OC_comments is used, not conversation.
